 Sandro Mamukelashvili (illness) questionable for Friday 
 by Leo Sells | Lakers Correspondent | Fri, Nov 6th 2026, 1:00pm EST 
 Sandro Mamukelashvili (illness) is questionable for Friday's game against the Portland Trail Blazers. ( NBA Injury Report ) 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 The big man is sick right now and is at risk of missing Friday's game as a result. If he's unable to play, look for Kevon Looney and Adou Thiero to benefit from his absence.
